scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/react dev
scripts.check-types: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/convex-better-auth check-types && bun run --filter './examples/*' check-types
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && cd e2e && bun run test
scripts.publint: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/convex-better-auth publint
scripts.ci:version: changeset version && bun run --cwd packages/convex-better-auth sync-version && bun install
